Smart Filters — Quick FAQ for support agents:  
What they are: Smart Filters are per-user saved views of the Conversations list that let an individual filter and save criteria; they are evaluated server-side and do not perform any automatic actions on conversations.  
Creation and limits: Each user can create up to 20 Smart Filters; saved filters apply only to the user who created them and do not become workspace defaults.  
What Smart Filters do NOT do: they do NOT delete, archive, close, or reopen conversations; they do NOT change other users’ views or workspace defaults; and they do NOT remove spam or run bulk-delete workflows.  
If you observe behavior that contradicts this (e.g., conversations being archived or other users’ views changing when filters are modified), escalate to Product/Engineering with screenshots and timestamps.

rounds.response: Smart Filters — quick contrasts for support agents: Smart Filters are per-user, server‑side evaluated saved views (each user can create up to 20); they only change what that user sees and never archive, delete, close, or reopen conversations. Search/regular filters are ad‑hoc queries you run to slice the list for the current session (they’re ephemeral and don’t change conversation state unless you run a bulk action). Tags are persistent labels attached to a conversation (visible to the workspace) and can be used as criteria in searches or Smart Filters; changing tags updates the conversation metadata for everyone. Bulk actions are manual operations you run on selected conversations (close, archive, delete, etc.); Smart Filters can help you find items to act on but do not trigger bulk actions automatically—escalate to Product/Engineering if you see automated state changes.
